name: Natural language to SQL (SQLite) with external knowledge
description: v1 plus an optional evidence input: a hint that maps the question's words to the data (BIRD's "external knowledge", e.g. "eligible free rate = Free Meal Count / Enrollment"). The hint line is left out when an item has none, so a v1 dataset renders the same under v2.
system: You are an expert SQLite developer. Given a database schema and a question, write one SQLite query that answers the question. Use only tables and columns from the schema. Reply with the SQL query only, no explanation.
